changes.desc: Fix: the LAZY TRANSITIONS, sticky scene, dimmed LED and SLICE PLAYHEAD state moved out of internal SRAM 0x80006a00..0x80007000, which lies inside the work buffer of a stock audio analysis task that overwrote it (saved track parameters, per-track part bytes, scene state), to DDR 0x40af0000 inside the dual-256 reserve. LAZY review fixes: a same-bank part change now dims and protects tracks (the test compared the bank only); re-applying the current part (edits, manual scene assign) is no longer reverted; an encoder move commits only a valid destination snapshot; the encoder commit runs with interrupts masked.

[PTN] + the trig of the playing pattern cues a restart: at the next CHAIN BEHAVIOR window (or the pattern end, whichever comes first) the pattern starts again from step 1, through the same switch a cue to another pattern takes. The trig shows the cued look while the restart is pending; a second press cancels it, and any other cue or STOP clears it. Not in arranger mode. Always on (stock does nothing for that press).

Fix: the [AUDIO EDITOR] key (and the open-on-SLICES shortcut) opens the editor on the current track's slot. Stock reused the slot published when the track was last selected, so after a track copy/paste or a part reload the editor showed the track's PREVIOUS sample (title, waveform, slices) while the track played another one. With the editor already open, a pattern change (same bank, or a bank pick with BANK AUTO PTN 1) or a part change now republishes the track's slot too, so the editor follows the sample the track plays instead of keeping the previous part's one until it is reopened (2i).

PERSONALIZE toggle BANK AUTO PTN 1: picking a bank in the SELECT BANK window also selects that bank's pattern 1 and closes the window, instead of waiting in BANK x: SELECT PTN. The [BANK]-held gesture, pattern chaining and the PTN key keep their stock paths. Off by default = stock byte-for-byte.

Fix: the SLICE PLAYHEAD trig LED (amber slice + beat blink) stands down while grid recording ([REC]) is on. The trig keys show steps there, but the view index still says SLICES, so the playing slice was painted amber on top of the step grid. The amber step indicator in REC is stock.

Fix: the SLICE PLAYHEAD hooks and the LAZY TRANSITIONS LED dimmer stand down while the [MIDI] mode is on. The view index they key on is shared with the MIDI pages (the MIDI ARP setup is also view 3), so the widget was drawn over the arpeggiator page, the T1-T8 LEDs dimmed for MIDI tracks and the trig LEDs were repainted from audio-track state; the exception seen on [PAGE] in a MIDI arp page came from that same unguarded path.

PERSONALIZE toggle SLICE PLAYHEAD: the SRC>SLICES view shows the playing slice number in a trig-key frame, a live progress bar and the slice's loop point; the playing slice's trig button lights amber and pulses with the tempo LED. Off by default = stock view byte-for-byte.

All custom PERSONALIZE toggles persist across power cycles and OS upgrades: the battery-SRAM settings restore covers the custom words (0x64 -> 0x70) and the setters write the checksummed shadow block.

STATIC sample slots 128 -> 256. High slots load samples, keep their slices, stay assigned to a track across a save/reload and a power cycle, accept parameter locks and play on the first trig. Persisted in project.work plus a project.256 sidecar. NEW IN 2.0.
10 extra arpeggiator key-scale qualities beyond major/minor (the five Greek modes, blues, phrygian-dominant, melodic-minor, octatonic, hirajoshi). OFF/maj/min stay byte-identical to stock.
On a pattern change to a different Part, sounding tracks keep the previous Part's sound (track LED dimmed) until a trig or an encoder move; A/B scene pointers stay on the same slots. Off by default.
SELECT BANK / SELECT PATTERN windows stop expiring. Off by default.
The behaviour switches are PERSONALIZE entries, unchecked by default, so an unconfigured unit behaves exactly like stock.
Boot splash and SYSTEM STATUS show OCTAMAX_2i instead of 1.40C.
